stock.description: Weihai City Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., established in 1997 and headquartered in Weihai, People's Republic of China, operates across the country through its various subsidiaries, providing a comprehensive range of financial services. Its core offerings span corporate banking, retail banking, and financial market activities. For individual customers, the bank facilitates deposit accounts, personal loans, wealth management, remittance solutions, and offers both debit and credit cards. Corporate clients benefit from services such as business loans and advances, trade financing, wealth management, consulting and advisory, settlement, guarantees, finance leasing, and agency services. In the financial markets, the company actively participates in inter-bank money market transactions, repurchase agreements, investment services, debt securities trading, and the issuance of debt instruments. Customers can access these services through numerous digital and physical channels, including online, mobile, direct, telephone, and WeChat banking, in addition to ATMs and self-service deposit/withdrawal machines, supported by its network of approximately 122 branches.
